avg_invoice_value.definition: Average invoice amount in the given period.

dispute_rate.definition: Disputes opened as a share of invoices issued: COUNT(disputes) / COUNT(invoices).

gross_revenue.definition: Gross revenue before refunds: total payments received, ignoring refunds.

refund_rate.definition: Refunds as a share of payments received: SUM(refunds) / SUM(payments).

refunds.definition: Total amount refunded to customers in the given period.

revenue.definition: Net revenue after refunds: total payments received minus total refunds, in the given period. Amounts in paise; divide by 100 for rupees.
